details.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
details.governing_law: laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

details.parties_quote: Vantage Biosciences Inc., a Massachusetts corporation having its principal office at 1 Kendall Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts 02139 (the "Company"); and AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation having its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 ("Vendor") (the "Recipient").

liability_cap.basis: liable for all losses arising from any breach, without limit
liability_cap.quote: The Recipient shall be liable for all losses arising from any breach, without limit, and the Company may seek injunctive relief without proof of damage.

details.one_sided_note: The Company has no obligation to keep confidential any information it receives from the Recipient, and may use that information for any purpose.

all_findings.title: Liability is unlimited
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts: 8 of 10 cap liability at about 1x fees; highest seen 2x.
all_findings.quote: The Recipient shall be liable for all losses arising from any breach, without limit, and the Company may seek injunctive relief without proof of damage.

all_findings.title: One-sided definition of Confidential Information
all_findings.why: Protects only the Company's information, ignoring AtliQ's disclosures.
all_findings.comparison: AtliQ principles require confidentiality to be mutual.
all_findings.quote: "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by the Company to the Recipient

all_findings.title: Company has no confidentiality obligations
all_findings.why: Exposes AtliQ's shared information to misuse by the client without restriction.
all_findings.comparison: AtliQ principles require confidentiality to be mutual.
all_findings.quote: The Company has no obligation to keep confidential any information it receives from the Recipient, and may use that information for any purpose.
